# Depth reference: modern art, active 1860-1960 (visual-art-plan.md §2.4).
# Generated by pipelines/visual_art/build_modern_reference.py, not by hand: movements and
# members from Wikidata (P135/P463; for non-Western movements also the artists linked from
# the movement's English Wikipedia article), ranked by Tate / MoMA / Wikidata-collection /
# regional-sweep holdings, none of which are depth-model features. QIDs, ranks and signals:
# data/interim/modern_reference_candidate.csv. Grouped by the movement's region.
# Format: "Movement: name, name, ...".
